findings.status: conditional source-level review candidate; uncounted pending central reconciliation
findings.observation: The bearing resolver allows a stair tread or landing with flight owner namespace to pair with GalleryFloor and computes their intersection using bounds() which rotates only yaw; it does not incorporate either crossfall or longfall. A checked SpatialBounds receives the intersection before a JunctionBond is recorded, but the audit of a bond also evaluates yaw-only solid bounds. A GalleryFloor producer explicitly gives its retained floor a 0.003-radian longfall and computes a crossfall, while collision projection retains all three orientations. The current generator resolves projected defenses before architectural envelope/spiral bearings.
findings.conditions_and_limits: A current eligible host role and nonzero longfall exist in source and pass through the reported ordering; no supported recipe with both a flight deck and the tilted host spatially overlapping is established. Actual contact geometry, a falsely accepted or missed bond, magnitude, violation of intended contact tolerances, and runtime effects are all unproved. An AABB is an explicit audit proxy; equality of producer and audit approximation alone does not establish physical contact.
findings.future_repair_direction: If supported overlapping geometry is shown, decide whether the shared authority needs a rotation-aware conservative bound plus an explicit contact narrow phase, or whether a documented bounded proxy/tolerance satisfies the physical policy; keep the declared bond and audit consistent and preserve separately owned role/identity rules. No repair performed.
